name: 14c-merge-messages-partial-options
description: The reference's destructuring defaults, per key rather than per object: the options object supplies only `strict` (`{ strict = false, placeholders = false, single = false, tools = false } = {}`, :827), so `placeholders`, `single` and `tools` must each fall back to false individually. `strict` with placeholders OFF is the observable part: a leading non-user turn does NOT get a placeholder unshifted (:943-947 is gated on placeholders), while the mid-prompt system demotion at :937-942 still runs. A port that reads the option flags with bare indexing -- or that fills defaults only when the whole object is absent -- fails here.
